result.title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
result.summary: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive experiments on four in-distribution and three out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DLaR achieves the highest average performance across model scales, reaching 27.9%/50.6% Pass@1/Pass@8 on Llama-3.2-1B and 46.8%/68.2% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Code: \href{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DLaR，在 GRPO 框架下对 latent reasoning 的随机性做动态控制：token 级用置信度-熵融合信号自适应调节每步扰动强度，训练级按课程逐步衰减基础随机性，从而形成分层探索-利用策略，并在数学推理基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 latent 工作，但其按步调节 latent 状态扰动强度、以不确定性决定探索的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、探索-利用权衡与信息坍缩抑制提供可迁移线索，需核查其不确定性信号在缺少视觉证据时是否仍适用。
